text_block_list.text: Cesario asked if I'd help eat a boxed lunch she made too much of—so after doing some shopping, we decided to have a picnic.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
You've been a tremendous help...
Here is the boxed lunch I mentioned earlier.
Spread out on the picnic sheet were bento boxes reminiscent of multi-tiered lacquer jubako from a high-end restaurant. And not just one, either.
choice_data_list: Well, you certainly made a whole lot.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... I actually managed to digest quite a bit.
I even shared some with everyone—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"...*burp*.
I hate to admit it, but I can't eat another bite."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Still, I have no regrets.
Thank you... for the... meal...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Spe-san...! 
Spe-saaaan!!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Cesario-chan!
I'll carry on Spe-san's legacy...!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Buena-san, but—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
You don't have much time before your outing, right?
If you just take a few boxes with you,
the rest of us in the dorm can eat the others—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Believe in us, Cesario-chan.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ...And here is the portion that was brought out.
choice_data_list: Well, with this amount, the two of us can manage if we try.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ...Thank goodness.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, I usually make a little too much
when I'm lost in thought, but...
This time, I really did go overboard, didn't I?
choice_data_list: ......What were you so worked up about?
......What were you so worried about?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Ah, umm... why don't we eat our lunch first?
I've started to get hungry too, you know?
choice_data_list: Ah, yeah—... Whoa, delicious!!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I'm glad!
There's plenty for seconds, so don't be shy♪

"Her cooking skills truly are professional-grade, as expected.
It was a huge portion, but I ended up polishing it all off in no time."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you, I was saved.
I don't even know how to thank you...
choice_data_list: We're partners, so rely on me as much as you need.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
You're right...
...Thank you.

Afterward—
we took a walk around the area for some post-meal exercise.
choice_data_list: So... can I ask what was troubling you?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: I—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: My own immaturity frustrates me so.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"My parents, everyone at the training club,
my school teachers, and my Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Surrounded by adults I can respect,
I consider myself truly blessed.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"However, because of that... I am frequently reminded
of my own inadequacies and immaturity—"

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ...Sometimes, it just becomes too much to bear.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I want to stand as an equal with the "Teachers"
I so respect as soon as possible... and yet.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: "I haven't the slightest clue how I might draw closer to it..."
choice_data_list: There's no need to rush.
Isn't that a good sign?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: However...!
choice_data_list: What do you think makes an adult truly an adult?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
Th-That's...
choice_data_list: I'd call it valuable experience.
I think it comes down to experience.

text_block_list.text: Sometimes it was just a casual scene from everyday life.
Or the moments spent competing against rivals.

I told her that this was the accumulation of the wonderful time
she was about to experience.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: "...Even our 'teachers' are who they are today because of all the countless experiences they've gathered."
choice_data_list: Let's cherish the journey of growing into adulthood.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

Besides, if Cesario catches up to us so quickly,
it leaves the adults with nowhere to stand.
choice_data_list: Let us act like the adults for a bit longer.
Let us act like the adults for a little longer.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Geez...! Adults are so unfair.

Cesario looked a mix of frustrated and pouting.
However, the gloom seemed to have vanished from her face.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ...May I ask what your intention is?
choice_data_list: You're right in the middle of growing.
You're right in the middle of growing right now.

text_block_list.text:
Only by worrying, hitting walls,
and overcoming them can a person truly grow.

I told her that the troubles she's facing now
will serve as nourishment for her future.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ...I see.
choice_data_list: Fret all you want—that's a kid's privilege, after all.
